subject: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage

Team —

We're getting increasing pressure from Axiom Health (enterprise pilot) on the model family phaseout timeline. They surfaced a few items today that need rapid cross-functional decisions so we can avoid a contractual SLA hit and a procurement escalation. High-level asks below; see attached tracker for row-level ownership.

Priority asks (short):
- Finalize allowed fallback model variants and perf SLA for their workflow (low-latency clinical summarization).
- Confirm cutover freeze window (how long will we support old variant under dedicated pool?).
- Legal/finance: confirm credit calculation approach if we offer a temporary runway.
- CS/sales: confirm ask cadence and whether Axiom should be routed to a dedicated onboarding lane.

Attachments: 20290610-migration-asks-tracker.xlsx (owner columns prefilled), Axiom-compat-report-20290609.pdf

Wanted to get a scoping call today if possible. My suggested immediate triage:
1) Jonas + Marissa — technical compatibility + customer impact (deadline by EOD tomorrow).
2) Laura + Ben — legal/contract and commercial remedy options (brief by EOD Wed).
3) I'll own stakeholder comms and executive update.

Can each of you confirm availability for a 30-minute sync today 3pm PT or otherwise give the single highest-priority blocker?

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the summary. Quick take after scanning the compat report and customer notes from the pilot:
- Axiom uses the old family for two pipelines: (A) near-real-time notes summarization (sequence length ~1k) and (B) batch chart extraction (long docs). Latency sensitivity is only for (A).
- For (A) we can recommend fallback to variant-v2-llamaQ (quantized) if we can guarantee tail latency at 95th <= 350ms. Need Jonas to validate perf on dedicated pool.
- For (B) they already accept async batch; we can propose an embedding-based backstop for edge cases.

I can be on the 3pm PT sync. I'll bring a short A/B compatibility matrix and suggested comm text for the customer (brief).

Attachments: (will attach matrix in the live doc during the call)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage

Thanks — reviewing perf matrix now. Short technical notes: 
- I ran quick microbenchmarks on dedicated with quantized variant-v2-llamaQ (seq len 1k, batch 1): p50=120ms, p95=380ms on current pool with prewarming. We are ~30ms over the 350ms target.
- Two levers to hit 350ms: (1) small prewarm on critical endpoints (keep warm on pool) or (2) temporary burst capacity (add 1x small GPU for their dedicated lane). Both are feasible but have cost and approval implications.
- KV-cache compatibility: we can retain prefix cache for majority of calls; migration of checkpoint ids will require a short client-side change (1 line) which Marissa should notify Axiom about.

I'll join 3pm and will bring a perf slide and cost delta estimate for the two levers.

—Jonas
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage

Folks —

Legal & commercial position:
- We can offer a short-term contractual runway (30 days) with a one-time operational credit tied to measured SLA breaches during the runway. I propose a standardized credit formula: credit = min(10% monthly commit, pro-rated SLA shortfall * weighting). Finance will need to sign off; Ben, can you intake and estimate the commercial impact?
- Any operational change that requires code updates (client-side checkpoint id) should be tracked as a change request; limit scope to avoid opening a maintenance storm. 

Also: procurement from EnableCloud is asking for an official rollout schedule and an auditor-friendly record of the fallback variants. We should prepare a sanitized variant inventory sheet to attach to procurement.

I'll be on the call tomorrow if needed; otherwise can draft the credit language for review.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Phaseout coordination: model family sunsetting — open asks & priority triage

Quick commercial update following numbers from finance:
- If we enable a 30-day runway + 1x burst GPU for their dedicated pool, estimated incremental cost = $6.4k (one-time operational) + ~$2.1k/mo amortized.
- Proposed customer-facing offer: 30-day runway + ops credit up to 8% of monthly commit if post-cutover SLA degradation occurs. That keeps our downside limited and gives Axiom runway to migrate.
- I'll prepare a one-page offer and run a quick consult with Sales Ops. Marissa — can you confirm whether Axiom will accept a 30-day operational runway or need 60? If 60 we need an exec approval because of cost.

I'll upload the commercial note to the HubSpot deal and attach the one-pager to the shared drive.

—Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
